text:
sasha: Morning — APAC edge cluster sg-edge-02 lost ~14 H100s in transit, flagged by depot. Need a mitigation plan: do we air-lift a handful or request loaners from EU pool?
vendor_nova: Hi Sasha, apologies. Origin factory delay + a DOA batch. Options: air 8 units (expedite fee $2.9k/unit), ship 10 refurb loaners from NL depot in 48h, or consolidate sea shipment (10-14 day). We can also fast-track RMA paperwork.
devin: Impact note: we already throttled a few gen routes; latency/p95 rising. If we only get 8 air units, still short ~6 GPUs for peak.
mike: Can non-realtime workloads fallback to A800 q8s for 1-2 weeks? Perf drop ~7-9% but faster to provision.
sasha: Good call — split plan favoured: air 8 for realtime, loaners 10 for batch jobs. Vendor: what RMA docs + customs info do you need?
vendor_nova: Need serial list, depot photos, DOA checklist (we'll prefill), signed AWB consent, and importer VAT number. HS code we use is 8471.80. We can pre-file with broker if you give contact.
tara: I'll gather photos and serials from SGP-DEP-11 now. Also confirming whether loaners include thermal housings and matching power cables.
rma-bot: [rma-bot] New RMA ticket: RMA-20260324-101 created by sasha. DOA_count=5.
devin: Quick finance check: air + customs puts unit cost high; if vendor can offer rebate on expedite we can justify. Also we may need a 24h dedicated burst in us-west to shed peak — estimate $8.2k.
vendor_nova: We can offer 10% expedite credit if you confirm the remainder of the PO (final 80 units) within 5 business days. Also willing to hold AWB 992-NVA-001 pending docs.
sasha: Okay. Action items: 1) tara — photos + serials by 09:45. 2) devin — list of critical endpoints (top 4) that must keep H100. 3) vendor_nova — hold tentative AWB until docs. 4) mike — plan to shift batch to A800s.
tara: Uploading photos and serial sheet now (SGP-DEP-11). Serial snippets: H100_SN [H100-9001,H100-9004,H100-9010,H100-9015,H100-9020]. Two units look DOA.
devin: Posting critical endpoints in #eng-oncall; will tag @sasha.
vendor_nova: Received serials/photos. Starting depot claim. We'll prepopulate DOA form and send pre-alerts to broker once provided. Air ETA post-clearance ~36-60h.
mike: If customs drags, approve the $8.2k us-west burst as contingency? We should cap exposure in PO amendment.
sasha: Approve up to $8.2k. vendor_nova, add contingency clause for expedite rebate and cap.
vendor_nova: Copy that. We'll include rebate language and an expedited-return SLA for loaners. Also attempting consolidated return AWB to minimize brokerage.
tara: Broker contact: simon@fastclear.co, VAT: RW-11223344. Sent to vendor_nova.
vendor_nova: Received broker info. We'll route AWB and pre-file. Tentative pre-clear tonight.
devin: I'll update on-call runbook and add routing rule to prefer dedicated fallback for non-critical endpoints during the swap.
sasha: Thanks. One more ask: can vendor include manifest with thermal kit part numbers so depot can stage firmware parity?
vendor_nova: Yes — manifest will include part numbers and firmware baseline. If loaners need firmware patching we'll schedule an overnight push from SGP-DP-11.
rma-bot: [rma-bot] RMA-20260324-101 updated: vendor_ack=true, AWB_hold=992-NVA-001.
sasha: Great work. Reconvene at 10:00 to confirm booking and any burst activation. :+1:
